mainSubject.label: Man cursed for his disbelief despite being created from a sperm-drop and destined, his way eased through life before death and burial await, with resurrection following divine will; he has not yet accomplished what was commanded; mankind directed to observe their food — water poured in torrents, earth broken open with sprouts producing grain, grapes, herbage, olives, palms, dense gardens, fruit and grass as enjoyment for humanity and livestock

subordinateSubjects.label: Cursed is man — how disbelieving he is
From what substance did Allah create him
From a sperm-drop He created and destined him
Then He eased the way for him through life
Then He causes his death and provides a grave
Then when He wills He will resurrect him
No — man has not yet accomplished what Allah commanded
Let mankind look at his food as a sign
Earth broken open and split with sprouts
Grain caused to grow within it
Olive trees and palm trees established
All as enjoyment for humanity and grazing livestock

commandsAndProhibitions.description: Let mankind look at his food as a sign of divine provision.
